notes.title: Update 1.0.47 (Improvements for Steam Deck)
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png"][/img][b]- Bug fix:[/b]
Fixed a collision problem in the second floor of the Guest House.
Fixed a camera transition bug in the main hall.[/p][p][/p][p][b]- Lighting:
[/b]Improved rendering for the "Low" shadow setting. Greatly improved light quality for the Steam Deck.

[i]Hotfix: Fixed an issue with blind monster's pathing in the abandoned floor.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.46
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Bug fix:[/b]
Correction of a problem causing Emily's imobilization in Hector's laboratory.

[b]- Improved game ergonomy:[/b]
Auto-aim is now deactivated after killing an enemy to prevent player disorientation when surrounded.
Simply press the aim button again to target the nearest enemy.

[b]- Widget:[/b]
Fixed visible outline on lantern icon for OLED display.

notes.title: Update 1.0.45
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Bug fix:[/b]
Fixed a problem causeing Emily to get stuck in aiming position despite releasing the dedicated key and forced the player to press the key again.

notes.title: Update 1.0.44
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.0.43 - Spanish version added
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Translation:[/b]
* Complete spanish translation.

[b]- Widget:[/b]
* Fixed various typos.
* Fixed a date error in a document for the English version.

[b]- Lighting:[/b]
* Fixed a lighting bug in the third floor when anti-aliasing was set to Low or Medium.

notes.title: Update 1.0.42
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Bugfix:[/b]
* Fixed an animation transition bug when Emily dies of suffocation.

[b]- Improved game ergonomy:[/b]
* Throwing a flask generates frames of invulnerability, preventing being hit by a Berserker attack.
* Added graphic elements allowing better orientation for certain fixed camera shots.

[b]- Widget:[/b]
* Fixed typos.

notes.title: Update 1.0.41
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Improved game ergonomy:[/b]
* Reduced cooldown between quick turns.
* Possibility to return to the aiming position during the transition aiming -> idle / movement animation.
* It is no longer necessary to press the aim input again to return to the aiming position after a hit from the boss Christy.
* Very slight cooldown reduction between rifle shots.
* Having the golden gun in the inventory no longer requires you to collect the basic handgun to access the boiler room at the end of the game.

[b]- Bugfix:[/b]
* It is no longer possible to do quick turn while reloading the rifle.
* Fixed an issue with Amber's animation triggering in the tunnel.

[i]Hotfix: The zombies cutscene is well triggered if the player enters the boiler room with the golden gun at the end of the game.[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.0.40
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Bugfix:[/b]
* It is no longer possible to insert a magazine in the golden gun.
* It is no longer possible to look at your ammo when Emily coughs.

[b]-Sound:[/b]
* Fixed a sound problem that reappeared following a previous modification.
The coughing sound can (really) no longer be heard during the end-game cutscene. 

[b]- Collision:[/b]
* Improved a collision issue in the passage leading to the mansion's balcony.

[b]- Widget:[/b]
* Fixed a syntax issue in a document for the English version of the game. 
* Fixed widget display issue for those playing with a 32:9 mod.
(The game is not natively compatible in this format.)

[b]- Improved game ergonomy:[/b]
* Added a very short cooldown after reloading to avoid wasting ammo by shooting before return to aiming animation.

notes.title: Update 1.0.39
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Bug fix:[/b]
* Fixed an issue with camera transition triggering in the back wing lobby of the mansion.
* Fixed an issue that could freeze the player during an interaction with the wine bottles in the basement.
* Fixed an issue causing ablility to move during the cat petting animation.
* Fixed a glitch allowing duplicating Glock magazines.

[b]- Improved game ergonomy:[/b]
* Berserker attacks no longer succeed if the player has interacted with a door, preventing the player from taking unfair damage.

[b]- Widget[/b]
* The Reload option no longer appears in the inventory for the Rifle if the player does not have any cartridges.

notes.title: Update 1.0.38
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Bug fix:[/b]
* Fixed a rare issue that could unable Emily to move forward and backward after closing inventory/storage.

[b]- Balancing:[/b]
* Increased frames to cancel Christy's attack.

notes.title: Update 1.0.37
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Bug fix:[/b]
* Fixed a bug that could stuck the player in the title menu after clicking on a end game bonus unlock screen.
* Fixed a bug causing the ability to shoot and use a flask during the game's opening screens.

[b]- Lighting:[/b]
* Fixed a small detail in the 2nd floor corridor leading to the gramophone room.

notes.title: Update 1.0.36
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

[b]- Bug fix:[/b]
* Fixed a bug causing incorrect interact information after inserted the two swords in the bunker.
* Fixed collision bug with library stairs.
* Fixed a bug giving the possibility for a zombie in the bunker to interact with Emily even when dead, if the player killed him using the gas room while having made the "Critical chance" wish at the fountain.
* Fixed a bug where it could be possible to shoot Cain's lantern in the boiler room when it was not yet placed.


[b]- Improved game ergonomics:[/b]
* Flasks can now be used by double clicking.
* Enlargement of the Cain's lantern hitbox used in the boiler room.


[b]- Others[/b]
* The small suitcase room is opened automatically once the player reaches the end of the game for narrative coherence.

notes.title: Update 1.0.35
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

-Bug:
Fixed a significant bug that could corrupt the save if the player opened a door while killed by a Berserker.
It should now be impossible to interact with a door in this case.

- Achievement:
Fixed an issue where the achievements “What a strange night” and “Need to rest” would not unlock if the player skipped the ending cutscene.

notes.title: Update 1.0.34
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

- Bug fix:
Fixed an issue causing the Cemetery Boss to become completely immobilized.
Fixed an issue causing the possibility of being bitten by a zombie that had just been killed by a flask.

- Widget:
The inventory and pause menu can no longer be opened after being killed by a blind monster.

notes.title: Update 1.0.33
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

- Widget:
Fixed an issue causing the mouse cursor to disappear from the main menu after navigating between different windows.

- Success:
Fixed an issue with the “Into the Flames” achievement triggering.

-Sound:
- The coughing sound can no longer be heard during the end-game cutscene.
( [i]This bug has reappeared. Fixed in version 1.0.40.[/i] )

notes.title: Update 1.0.32
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43658609/56d3c710cbdac6acc69332760f43570d5c392a05.png[/img]

- Bug fix: 
The bite animation is no longer played when a zombie grabes Emily just before she dies.

- Improved game ergonomy: 
Coughing no longer requires the player to repress the aim or run key at the end of animation.

- Balancing:
Difficulty reduction in the tunnel at the end of the game.

- Widget:
Correction of typo errors in the French version.
